sources.title: Intake notes
sources.excerpt: Every submission needs a title and a category; reviewers cannot triage a record without both.

claims.statement: A submission needs a title and a category before a reviewer can triage it.
The current queue lists waiting submissions oldest first.
Reassignment during a review is rare.
claims.note: No evidence yet; raised while shaping slice.reassignment.

actors.title: Requester
actors.description: Submits records that need a review.

actors.title: Reviewer
actors.description: Works the shared queue and resolves the submissions assigned to them.

journeys.title: Submit a record and get it reviewed
journeys.goal: A complete submission reaches the right reviewer and is resolved.

steps.text: The reviewer sees it in the queue.

rules.title: Title and category are required
rules.statement: A submission without a title or a category is rejected with a message naming each missing field, and nothing is queued.
rules.explanation: Reviewers cannot triage a record without both fields.

examples.outcome: Accepted; appears in the queue as Waiting.
Rejected: 'Category is required'. The queue is unchanged.

rules.title: Queue lists oldest first
rules.statement: The queue lists waiting submissions oldest first.

rules.title: Only the assigned reviewer resolves
rules.statement: Only the reviewer a submission is assigned to can resolve it.

examples.situation: S-1 is assigned to reviewer R1; R2 tries to resolve it.
examples.outcome: Refused: 'Assigned to another reviewer'. S-1 stays In review.

rules.title: Reassignment during a review
rules.statement: When a submission is reassigned during a review, the new reviewer takes it over; what happens to the previous reviewer's unsaved work is not decided.

scenarios.title: Submit a complete record
scenarios.goal: Submit a record and see it reach the review queue.
expected: The queue shows 'Laptop request' with status Waiting.
The summary count of waiting submissions goes from 0 to 1.

scenarios.title: Submit without a category
scenarios.goal: Submit a record without a category.
expected: The form shows 'Category is required' next to the category field.
The queue and the summary count are unchanged.

scenarios.title: Resolve an assigned submission
scenarios.goal: Resolve a submission assigned to you.
expected: S-1 shows Approved and leaves the waiting count.

scenarios.title: Reassign during a review
scenarios.goal: Hand a submission you are reviewing to another reviewer.
expected: Not decided: what happens to reviewer-1's unsaved notes.

questions.title: Reject or hold incomplete submissions?
questions.decision_needed: Is a submission missing a required field rejected, or held as a draft?
questions.why_it_matters: Holding drafts needs draft storage and a draft list; rejecting does not.

options.choice: Reject with a message naming the missing field.
options.tradeoff: Simple; the requester re-enters the form.

options.choice: Hold as a draft the requester completes later.
options.tradeoff: Friendlier; adds draft state and storage.

questions.recommendation: Reject with a message; drafts can be a later slice.

questions.title: What happens on reassignment during a review?
questions.decision_needed: When a submission is reassigned during a review, what happens to the previous reviewer's unsaved notes and draft decision?
questions.why_it_matters: It decides whether the data model keeps per-reviewer drafts and what the new reviewer sees.

options.choice: Keep the draft with the submission and show it to the new reviewer.
options.tradeoff: No lost work; needs a draft record and a visibility rule.

questions.recommendation: Keep the draft with the submission; confirm who may see it.

decisions.title: Reject incomplete submissions
decisions.question: question.missing-field-behaviour
decisions.choice: Reject a submission missing a required field, with a message naming each missing field.
decisions.rationale: Keeps the first slice small; drafts are not needed for the first release.
evidence: Product owner review of scenario.submit-missing-category on 2026-11-09 (synthetic).
Recorded locally by Main from the owner's reply in the review session (synthetic).
